title: FIPS operational: FIPS aggregate status doesn't identify failing provider
description: CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_STATUS returns CRYPTO2DEV_FIPS_NOT_OPERATIONAL (src/cdev/crypto2dev_fd.c:1118-1130) but does not identify which provider's fips_gate is failing. crypto2dev_fips_aggregate() (registry.c:273-307) iterates providers, stops at first gate failure, returns a state code. In a multi-provider deployment (wolfssl + hardware accel), the caller cannot determine which provider to remediate. The FIPS_NOT_OPERATIONAL code should be paired with a pr_err naming the failing provider, or the status struct should include a provider name field.
close_reason: Addressed by dfn.14 fix: pr_err_ratelimited in wolfssl_fips_gate identifies the failing provider
